title: Version Fingerprinting Methodology
description: Prerequisite for all CVE targeting: pin down the version first
detail: Order: 1) response headers/cookie names (X-Powered-By, JSESSIONID, PHPSESSID, think_var) 2) favicon hash 3) error page stack traces 4) /actuator /package.json /composer.json /.git/HEAD 5) whatweb. Pin down the version → check kb050 → if nothing matches, run the full nuclei template set (rate-limited). Do not spray payloads blindly when the version is unknown.
